senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; <he>מְשֻׁלָּשׁ</he>; denom. of <cite ref="U01386"><he>שָׁלשׁ</he></cite>) ; pl. <he>מְשׁוּלָּשִׁים</he>, <he>מְשׁוּלָּשִׁין</he>

units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 1:3:3">Y. Shebi. I, 33ᵇ</cite> <he>חשבין מ׳</he> the quantity (of one cake of figs) for each three trees out of nine.
